key_findings.finding: All five reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs are annotated as mannosyl-oligosaccharide alpha-1,2-mannosidase, EC 3.2.1.113, placing the query's PF01532 Glyco_hydro_47 region in glycoside hydrolase family 47 (GH47), specifically the ER/N-glycan-processing alpha-1,2-mannosidase family. The query's family assignment is strongly supported by direct homolog annotations, but its exact substrate specificity remains an inference from homology/domain architecture because the query itself was not directly assayed.

The curated reaction represented by Rhea 56008/56028 is hydrolysis of alpha-1,2-linked mannose residues from high-mannose N-glycans: Man9GlcNAc2 (or Man8GlcNAc2 isomer) + water -> Man5GlcNAc2 + 4 (or 3) beta-D-mannose. The detailed Rhea-linked reactions are also associated with RHEA:14356/14367 and RHEA:14358/14367, respectively.

The homolog records identify a proton-donor active-site residue and calcium-ion binding, supporting a divalent-metal-dependent GH47 mechanism.
